title: What common contract must every stance explain?
question: What common contract must every stance explain?
answer: WB-12: A stance never grants, removes or transfers authority; it only changes how the model behaves within authority set before adoption. Every stance defines Purpose, Method / Posture, Obligations, and Completion / Exit Condition, and may add intrinsic constraints (e.g. Reviewer evaluates rather than quietly repairs). Changing stance creates no handoff, so one task may move Builder -> Reviewer -> Builder -> Reconciler uninterrupted.
